description: Defines the VueControllerHelper class, a PHP helper class that facilitates the integration of Vue.js components within the OrangeHRM system. It manages context parameters, user data, menu items, theme data, and permissions for rendering Vue components in the application.

classes.name: VueControllerHelper
classes.description: A helper class that assembles context data, manages user and menu information, and provides supporting methods to facilitate Vue.js component integration in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Assembles and returns an array of context parameters for Vue components, including user info, menu items, theme data, and other configuration.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Returns the current assets version string based on build timestamp.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the currently logged-in user's ID.

methods.name: getUserObject
methods.description: Constructs and returns an array with logged-in user details, including profile image URL, name, and password status.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Fetches the menu items for the current request base URL.

methods.name: getContextItems
methods.description: Retrieves current screen context information, such as screen name and icon.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: getBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs the breadcrumb navigation data based on current module and screen.

methods.name: getHelpUrl
methods.description: Constructs the help URL based on the current module and screen.
